pages.title: Tea Plants
pages.text: $(bold)Where it grows:$() Warm and humid climates.$(br)$(bold)Temperature:$() 10°C to 26°C$(br)$(bold)Rainfall:$() 250 - 950 mm$(br2)$(bold)Seasonality:$() Flowers in April, leaf-gathering seasons in May–June and August–September. Dormant in winter.$(br2)$(thing)Tea Bush & Tree:$() Planting a sapling in soil grows a 2-block-tall $(thing)Tea Bush$(). If left unharvested for 2 full years, it transforms into a $(thing)Tea Tree$(). In a greenhouse bonsai planter, it grows as a tree directly.
A mature Tea Tree (left) and two-block Tea Bush (right).

pages.title: Coffee Trees
pages.text: $(bold)Where it grows:$() Tropical climates.$(br)$(bold)Temperature:$() 16°C to 36°C$(br)$(bold)Rainfall:$() 200 - 900 mm$(br2)$(bold)Seasonality:$() Flowers in May–June, fruiting in September–October. Dormant in winter.$(br2)$(thing)Growth Rules:$() Coffee grows only as a fruit tree. In the wild, it requires 2 full years of growth before first fruiting (from year 3). In a greenhouse $(l:firmalife/planters)Bonsai Planter$(), coffee fruits immediately without waiting!
